blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA—Under the bright lights of the Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium, John Cabang Tolentino did more than hurdle his way to a historic Asian Games bronze. Tolentino’s 13.48‑second season‑best run in the men’s 110m hurdles final on Sunday night was a moment of redemption, putting him squarely on the path toward the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, where he now aims to make his biggest stride yet. “Even in the hard times, I kept pushing.
